subject: Post-demo: token budget playbook & context-range options
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@foldcommerce.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token budget playbook & context-range options

Samira — thanks for carving out time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can turn the demo into a concrete pricing proposal. Notes below intentionally concise.

1) Call summary (one-liner)
- Fold Commerce wants to power product search + real-time recommendations for web + mobile. Expect mixed short queries (search/autocomplete) and longer assistant-style responses for product explanations. Need background context for session history (mostly recent 3–5 interactions) and occasional long-context product graph snapshots.

2) Clarified usage mix (please confirm):
- Typical interactive session: avg prompt ~180 tokens, avg completion ~1,100 tokens (long tail).
- Monthly active sessions: ~25k sessions/month initially, with ~2 requests per session on average => ~50k requests/mo.
- Token breakout (current expectation): ~50M prompt tokens/mo, ~275M completion tokens/mo => ~325M total tokens/mo (approx).

3) Context-range needs (approx frequency):
- 8k context (default): ~75% of requests (search + short threads).
- 32k context: ~20% (product graph slices, 3–5 docs appended).
- 128k context: ~5% (rare analytic / deep troubleshooting sessions).

4) Target economics from your side (you said $/1M target):
- You mentioned target $/1M tokens in the ballpark of $220–$320. We can work with that range with committed volume and limited SLA adjustments.

5) Preliminary Redwood scenarios (attached spreadsheet has the math):
- Scenario A (Standard hosted, no commit): ~ $420 / 1M tokens (baseline using our 8k-optimized variant).
- Scenario B (12-month reserved commit, mixed-context pricing & quantization): ~ $260 / 1M tokens (assuming 325M tokens/mo and 15% effective batching savings).
- Scenario C (Dedicated + on-prem cache for 32k/128k hot-prefix): ~ $160 / 1M tokens (higher operational commit + multi-month upfront).

Notes on assumptions: model choice and quantization materially affect unit cost (we assumed a 7B-class open variant for Baseline, 13B-optimized for mixed). We also layer in auto-prefix KV caching for repeated session context (we modeled 12–18% token savings).

6) Next asks from us (action items):
- Please confirm or correct the monthly token estimates above (prompts/completions split).
- Tell us whether the 128k windows will be for <1% of sessions or closer to 5% — that changes memory/eviction sizing.
- Confirm whether Fold Commerce can consider a 12-month committed tier (we can then firm up Scenario B pricing).

Attachments: Rdl_Token_Scenarios_03-27.xlsx (scenario math & unit-econ table) attached.

If you prefer, we can also sketch a hybrid commit: guaranteed baseline commit for the first 6 months + flexible overages with a step-down unit price after hitting thresholds.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marcus on the pricing mechanics and Laura on contract terms once you confirm numbers.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
(attachment: Rdl_Token_Scenarios_03-27.xlsx)
From: Samira Qureshi <samira@foldcommerce.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token budget playbook & context-range options

Grace — super helpful recap, thanks. Quick clarifications from our side so your scenarios line up: 

- The avg prompt figure you used (180) looks right per our telemetry, completion average is slightly lower than you estimated — should be closer to 950 tokens on average once we truncate boilerplate, but the long tail (occasional 3–4k completions) skews the mean up. So for modeling please use 950 completion tokens as a conservative baseline and include a 7% "long-tail uplift" to account for occasional long runs.
- Monthly session math: we expect a conservative L1 launch at ~22k active sessions, rising to 30k by Q4. For the initial commercial proposal, model 22k sessions (44k requests) and provide a sensitivity table at 30k sessions.
- Context windows: 128k will be very rare — more like 2% of requests. 32k will be used for feature enrichment and should be priced differently if it requires Dedicated capacity.

Interested in Scenario B if we can get the unit down closer to $240 / 1M tokens on the commit — can you show a path to that number (mix of quantization + 10% commit uplift)?

One more ask: can you include a line item for streaming latency targets (p50/p95) for each scenario? Our engineering team needs to map to SLIs.

Thanks — I can share our internal token telemetry if helpful (CSV).

Samira Qureshi
Head of Product, Fold Commerce
samira@foldcommerce.com
(212) 555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira@foldcommerce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 17:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token budget playbook & context-range options

Thanks Samira — a few quick notes from pricing/solutions perspective: 

- Path to $240 / 1M: feasible with a 12-month commit + curated quantization profile (we can push most high-frequency short queries onto an 8-bit optimized variant and keep 32k/128k on 16-bit optimized variants). The attached spreadsheet includes a "quantization mix" sheet that models a blended unit cost; with a 10% commit uplift (i.e., guaranteed 360M tokens/mo over 12 months) plus 12% batching/prefix-saving we can hit $235–$255 / 1M depending on the final model split.
- Streaming SLIs: baseline hosted p50 ~45–55ms per chunk, p95 ~190–240ms per chunk for 8k workloads (these change for 32k/128k windows; dedicated deployments lower p95 by ~30–40%). We'll include a p50/p95 matrix per scenario in the next doc.
- Contract mechanics: Laura, please prepare a short-form MOA with a 30-day review clause and a standard data-processing addendum. I recommend we offer a 6-month ramp schedule (60% of commit in months 1–2, 85% by month 3) to be realistic on their side.

Samira — if you can share the CSV telemetry (tokens by request type + frequency of 32k/128k usage) we can lock the sensitivity table quickly. Also confirm whether Fold Commerce requires SOC2 evidence up-front; if so we will include the compliance pack link.

Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@foldcommerce.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token budget playbook & context-range options

Samira — great, thanks for the numbers. Quick agreed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- You: share token telemetry CSV (tokens/request, flag for 32k/128k) by end of week.
- We (Marcus + Pricing): deliver updated Scenario B that targets $235–$245 / 1M with commit tiers and latency matrix (EOD Thurs).
- Laura (Contracts): draft MOA + DPA for a 12-month commit with a 6-month ramp and standard termination windows.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute pricing review this Friday — proposed slot: Fri 10:00–10:30 PT. Confirm or suggest an alternative.

If we get the CSV quickly we can cut the first pricing deck in 48 hours.

Calendar: https://calendly.com/grace-oconnor/redwood-fold-pricing-review

Thanks again — looking forward to locking this in.

Grace
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
